 Wesli De Cremer averages 4.60 yellow cards and 0.30 red cards per match across the 20 matches analysed: 4.90 cards per match in total.

 Wesli De Cremer has awarded 10 penalties in the 20 matches analysed, averaging 0.50 per match.

 Across the 20 matches in the sample, the total exceeded 3.5 cards in 75.0% of matches, 4.5 in 70.0% and 5.5 in 35.0%.
 How much does Wesli De Cremer’s card count vary between matches?
 Of the 20 matches analysed, 10.0% ended with 0–2 cards, 55.0% with 3–5 and 35.0% with 6 or more.
 How do Wesli De Cremer’s latest ten matches compare within this sample?
 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 4.80 cards, compared with 4.90 across all 20 matches analysed.

 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 1.95 yellow cards and away teams 2.65. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
